issues: 点开的是「Confidence-routed model cascade」卡，窗里长出来的却是同一列表页的下半截——不是这张卡的详情，语义断裂（卡片自己的已知坑）
卡片从静止直接开始放大，没有「点开」这个动作的预备（无悬浮、无按下），像自动擦除
放大过程中背后的列表页纹丝不动、亮度不变，窗与背景没有主次层级
窗的阴影是固定一档，飞行中没有高度变化；卡片脸随窗变宽被横向拉伸
changes: 目标卡换成 nano-lab（card9），窗内换成同一项目的 detail-full 详情页——标题一致，「点开一张卡进入它的世界」语义闭环
补齐点开动作：0–26f 页面惯性滚到页底 → 光标滑上卡片 → 卡片悬浮抬起 8px、放大 2.5%、阴影变大变虚 → 按下微缩 → 40f 起放大成窗
窗几何与窗内景保持同一个 t（45f 单段 bezier，窗内 0.42→1 反向补偿，卡脸 opacity 1−t·2.2），卡脸改 object-fit: cover 不再拉伸
背景列表页随窗变大压暗 22% + 虚化 3px；窗挂随高度变化的两层软阴影（悬浮 18 → 飞行 ~56 → 铺满归零）；85f 起详情页真静止 35f
issuesEn: The card being opened was 'Confidence-routed model cascade', but what grew inside the window was just the lower half of the same list page — not that card's detail, breaking the meaning (the card's own known pitfall)
The card started scaling from a dead stop, with no anticipation of a click (no hover, no press), so it read as an automatic wipe
The list page behind stayed perfectly still and fully lit, so there was no hierarchy between window and background
The window shadow was a single fixed level with no change in height, and the card face stretched horizontally as the window widened
changesEn: The target is now the nano-lab card (card9) and the window reveals that project's detail-full page — same title, so 'open a card and enter its world' closes the loop

The click is now acted out: the page momentum-scrolls to the bottom (0–26f) → a cursor glides onto the card → the card lifts 8px, scales 2.5% and its shadow grows softer → a press dip → it expands from 40f
Window geometry and inner scene still share one t (single 45f bezier, inner 0.42→1 counter-scale, face opacity 1−t·2.2); the face uses object-fit: cover so it no longer stretches

The list page darkens 22% and blurs 3px as the window grows; the window carries a two-layer soft shadow that changes with height (hover 18 → flight ~56 → zero when full); the detail page holds truly still from 85f for 35f
